details: Paul Grewal, Chief Legal Officer at Coinbase, has resigned from his position, effective July 31, 2026, but will remain with the company in an advisory capacity. His departure follows significant legal battles with US regulators.
title: Coinbase CLO Paul Grewal Steps Down, Transitions to Advisory Role

details: Bitwise analysts report that Bitcoin's fundamental value is increasing, even amidst the current focus on AI investments and ongoing regulatory uncertainties. This suggests underlying strength in Bitcoin's market position.
title: Bitwise: Bitcoin's Floor Rising Despite AI Boom, Regulatory Delays

details: According to CryptoQuant, the recent rebound in Bitcoin's price is indicative of a bear-market recovery rather than a definitive trend reversal. This suggests caution for investors expecting a sustained upward trajectory.
title: CryptoQuant: Bitcoin Rebound is Bear Market Recovery, Not Trend Reversal

details: New Hampshire has declined a proposal for a $100 million Bitcoin-backed bond after a public finance hearing. This decision could reflect ongoing caution from state governments regarding direct integration of cryptocurrencies into public finance.
title: New Hampshire Rejects $100M Bitcoin-Backed Bond

details: Bitcoin has maintained its price above the $60,000 mark, demonstrating resilience despite escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran. This suggests a potential safe-haven characteristic for Bitcoin in times of global instability.
title: Bitcoin Resilient Above $60K Amid US-Iran Hostilities

details: The LAB token experienced a dramatic 80% crash, losing $5 billion in market capitalization within 48 hours. On-chain investigator ZachXBT alleged the token was "95% insider-controlled," leading to heavy selling and forced unwinding around concentrated ownership.
title: LAB Token Crashes 80% Amid Insider-Control Allegations

details: Days after its mainnet launch, Robinhood Chain's ecosystem has seen explosive growth, with daily DEX trading volume exceeding $560 million and active addresses nearing 200,000. This pushed Robinhood Chain past Base as the second-largest Uniswap deployment chain, causing ARB to surge over 15%.
title: Robinhood Chain Mainnet Launch Sparks Explosive Ecosystem Growth

details: Singapore's state-owned investment firm Temasek Holdings is pivoting to prioritize AI investments over crypto due to ongoing regulatory uncertainty and the lasting impact of a $275 million loss from the FTX collapse in 2022.
title: Temasek Shifts Focus to AI, Deprioritizes Crypto Investments
